          - "//w:hyperlink[@w:anchor=\"{{bookmark:tbl-cars}}\"]"

          - "//w:tbl//w:r//w:t[text()=\"(b) Pressure\"]"

          - "//w:tbl//w:bookmarkStart[@w:name=\"{{bookmark:tbl-cars}}\"]"
          - "//w:tbl//w:bookmarkStart[@w:name=\"{{bookmark:tbl-pressure}}\"]"
          - "//w:bookmarkStart[@w:name=\"{{bookmark:tbl-tables}}\"]"
        - []
---

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tables
#| tbl-cap: "Tables"
#| layout-ncol: 2

library(knitr)
kable(head(cars), caption = "Cars {#tbl-cars}")
kable(head(pressure), caption = "Pressure {#tbl-pressure}")
```

See @tbl-cars and @tbl-pressure for more information.
